metadata.name: Audit Logging & Monitoring Core Infrastructure
metadata.description: Comprehensive audit logging, monitoring, and alerting system for detecting unauthorized access, security incidents, and compliance violations.

auditLogging.principle: Log everything: WHO did WHAT with WHAT data at WHEN from WHERE

storage.location: Immutable audit log storage (AWS S3 with object lock, or equivalent)
storage.encryption: Encrypted at rest; access restricted to compliance team
storage.tamperDetection: Cryptographic hash chain or append-only database to detect tampering

metrics.name: authentication_failures
metrics.threshold: Alert if > 10 failed logins per user per hour

metrics.name: api_abuse
metrics.threshold: Alert if API key exceeds rate limit (e.g., 1000 requests/min)
metrics.action: Throttle API key; notify user and admin

metrics.name: unauthorized_access
metrics.threshold: Alert on any 403 Forbidden errors (authorization failure)
metrics.action: Log suspicious pattern; monitor for repeat attempts

metrics.name: data_exfiltration
metrics.threshold: Alert if single user downloads >100MB in 1 hour

metrics.name: malware_detected
metrics.threshold: Alert on any malware detection in upload
metrics.action: Quarantine file; notify user and admin

metrics.name: encryption_key_access
metrics.threshold: Alert on every encryption key access
metrics.action: Log immediately; review in monthly audit

metrics.name: system_errors
metrics.threshold: Alert on error rate > 5% for any endpoint

channels.severity: Highest priority (encryption key breach, data exfiltration)

channels.automation: Create Jira ticket automatically for investigation

frequency.review: Automated alerts; failed login patterns; API abuse
Data access patterns; unusual geographic locations; role changes
Comprehensive audit log analysis; user access review
Regression testing: verify logging is working correctly

reports.name: Annual Compliance Report
reports.contents: IRS Pub 1075 compliance status, audit findings, certification

requirements.name: logging-completeness
requirements.test: Verify all security-relevant events are logged
requirements.method: Perform action (login, download, etc.); verify log entry created

requirements.name: log-integrity
requirements.test: Verify logs cannot be tampered with
requirements.method: Attempt to modify audit log entry; verify rejected

requirements.name: alert-accuracy
requirements.test: Verify alerts fire when thresholds exceeded
requirements.method: Trigger condition (>10 failed logins); verify alert sent

tools: ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for log aggregation
Datadog or New Relic for monitoring and alerting
